name: Nephilim
source:
"Hmph... Hehehe..."

A legendary killer who appears out of nowhere. He wears a tattered costume that was once an amusement park mascot. Cruel and violent. Uses a grotesque jackhammer as a weapon.

[From [url=https://x.com/SpikeChunsoft_e/status/1936831550957523170]official Twitter[/url]]

[spoiler]There are two Nephilims. This one is a hallucination caused by the drug "Virus" that induces violence and self-mutilation in victims, emulating the Nephilim murders. The other is [url=/c157540]Fushicho Kagura[/url], who drugs these victims.[/spoiler]
